column1: # port/tools/return-type-allow.tsv: reviewed -Wreturn-type / -Wreturn-mismatch hits in SHIPPED port bodies
# (scripts/port-gate.sh, run 842).  A hit that is neither listed here nor in a dropped copy (a definition
# port/sourcemap.tsv ships from another unit: cc-select renames it __port_dead_*, --gc-sections drops it)
# fails the gate.  Review = read the ROM asm for $v0 at the fall-off point:
#   - a meaningful value its callers read  -> fix it (PORT_V0_RET / PORT_V0_TYPE in include/uso_call.h,
#     or `#ifdef PORT return x; #endif`), do NOT list it;
#   - otherwise list it with the verdict:
#     VOIDLEFT  $v0 is a void callee's leftover (the original function was void; no caller can use it)
#     UNUSED    $v0 is defined, but no caller (direct, tail or dispatch) reads it
#     DEAD      the warned return is unreachable, or the body is not linked into tenshoe
#     KR        the implicit-int warning of a K&R definition (its fall-off is reviewed on its own line)
